verdict.rationale: Granola documents its own speaker-tag feature that shows each participant's name above their part of the conversation, going beyond the default 'Me' and 'Them' labels. That directly addresses named attribution, but it is one thin doc mention, and the default labeling is still only Me/Them. Missing for 10: how names are matched to voices (calendar invitees or enrollment), whether it is on by default and which platforms or plans have it, accuracy with many speakers or in-person meetings, and independent or hands-on corroboration that attribution is correct.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Speaker tags show each participant's name above their parts of the conversation, giving you more detailed attribution than the default Me and Them labels.
